question: Should OpenClaw ship this public query-only preprocessing option for Qwen3 and Mixedbread, or redesign it into a broader query/document preprocessing contract that can correctly support Nomic?
rationale: Removing Nomic is a mechanical correction, but the permanent config and plugin/provider API boundary—and whether document preprocessing belongs in it—requires maintainer product and compatibility intent.

options.title: Narrow to query-only families
options.body: Remove Nomic and retain the default-off Qwen3 and Mixedbread behavior in this PR.

options.title: Design full preprocessing contract
options.body: Expand the abstraction to per-family query and document transforms with index identity and safe rebuild behavior.

options.title: Decline the public option
options.body: Keep model-specific preprocessing provider-owned or outside the current memory configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Narrow to query-only families
recommendation.body: Remove Nomic and retain the default-off Qwen3 and Mixedbread behavior in this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history spans memory configuration, provider composition, SDK boundaries, and reindex compatibility.
